🌟 awesome-mac | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: Discovering and finding high-quality software for macOS.
✨ Key Features: • Curated list of high-quality macOS software • Systematic organization by category • Facilitates easy search and discovery
📖 Summary: This repository is a curated list of high-quality macOS software, organized by category to facilitate easy discovery and use. It aims to be a comprehensive resource for Mac users looking for reliable applications.
